The provided <.SRCINFO> file is a metadata file commonly found in Arch User Repository (AUR) packages. This file does not contain executable code and is used by AUR helpers and packaging tools to manage the build and installation process.

The source is specified as a git repository from the project's official GitHub URL (https://github.com/naurissteins/sweetidle.git), which aligns with the declared upstream. No suspicious network activity, obfuscated commands, or unauthorized file operations are present in this metadata file. All listed dependencies and optional dependencies are reasonable for a Rust-based system daemon targeting Wayland compositors. The package provides a git version of `sweetidle`, conflicts with the stable version, and includes systemd integration as an optional feature — all of which are consistent with typical AUR packaging practices.

Environment variables like `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` are explicitly set but point to standard, stable Rust toolchain, which is safe.

The `package()` function installs built binaries and documentation files to standard system paths using `install`, which is consistent with packaging norms. The installed files include a systemd user service and example configuration, which are reasonable for the application's functionality.
